LESSON: PRANAYAM (BREATHING EXERCISES)

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: General
Strand: Yoga
Topic 6.1: Pranayam (Breathing exercises)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Pranayam (Breathing exercises), part of Yoga in Grade 4 General.

Key inquiry question: How does performing Pranayam help in correct breathing? 2. Why is it important to perform asanas in the presence of an expert?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. name the types of Pranayam for familiarisation,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Pranayam (Breathing exercises) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

I. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify Pranayam using digital device,
2. perform under the supervision of an able resource person,
3. participate in the celebration of International Yoga Day and take photos/videos,
4. collect pictures from magazines/newspapers/digital devices to create a chart,
5. practise asanas, in pairs or groups, to encourage each other,
6. create a Yoga guidance video using digital devices,
7. Assist learners with special needs as per their abilities through peer teaching to make them understand basic Pranayam and asanas in 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Pranayam (Breathing exercises) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

other.

● Digital Literacy: Learner interacts with technology when participating in the celebration of International Yoga Day and takes

photos/videos.

Values:
Responsibility: Learner practises diligence when collecting pictures from magazines/newspapers/digital devices to create a chart.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

magazines/newspapers/digital devices to the creative skills learnt in Creative Arts.
